reason: The cited evidence (E1) only states that CoCrFeNiTi_x alloys change from FCC to intermetallic phases with varying Ti concentration and that post-treatments can enhance mechanical performance. It does not provide specific support for any of the key premises about single-phase solid solution formation at equimolar composition, the magnitude of lattice distortion, its insufficiency for dislocation pinning, or the specific role of precipitates in strengthening.
premises: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi can be produced as a single-phase solid solution
Ti in solid solution causes only moderate lattice distortion
Moderate lattice distortion alone is insufficient to significantly impede dislocation motion
Secondary precipitates (σ, R, Laves) act as effective dislocation pinning centers
Controlled annealing can induce fine precipitates without gross phase separation
